name: Deploy to Firebase Hosting
description: A GitHub Action to deploy to Firebase Hosting

expires.description: How long should a preview live? See the preview channels docs for options

projectId.description: The project to deploy to. If you leave this blank, make sure you check in a .firebaserc file

channelId.description: The ID of the channel to deploy to. If you leave this blank, a preview channel and its ID will be auto-generated per branch or PR.

target.description: The target name of the Hosting site to deploy to. If you leave this blank, the default target or all targets defined in the .firebaserc will be deployed to. Ref

entryPoint.description: The location of your firebase.json file, relative to the root of your directory

firebaseToolsVersion.description: The version of firebase-tools to use. Defaults to `latest`.
